_comment: The REQUESTED -> APPROVED/REJECTED lifecycle for a cashier-created void, added in Stage 4 remediation pass 3. Complements void-example.json, which only covers the immediate-execution case (requester already holds SALE_VOID_APPROVE). Here the requester is a plain Cashier -- the void sits pending until a separate Manager acts on it, potentially at a different terminal/session, per personas.md's explicit 'avoid doing anything that requires calling the manager mid-transaction' design goal.

body.reason: Customer changed their mind before leaving the store

response_201.reason: Customer changed their mind before leaving the store

step_1_cashier_requests._note: sale.status stays COMPLETED -- it only becomes VOIDED at the APPROVED -> VOIDED execution step. This is exactly why GET /sales's own status filter can never surface a pending void; GET /voids?status=REQUESTED is the only way to find it.

data.reason: Customer changed their mind before leaving the store

response_200.reason: Customer changed their mind before leaving the store

step_3a_manager_approves._note: terminal_id/fiscal_day_id/shift_id are the APPROVING manager's own currently-open terminal/fiscal_day/shift -- terminal-2, not the cashier's original terminal-1 -- populated only now, at APPROVED -> VOIDED execution (Stage 2 amendment pass 3).

step_3b_manager_rejects_instead._comment: Alternative to step_3a -- shown for completeness, not a continuation of the same void (void-9 can only resolve once, invariants.md #21).

body.reason: Item was already bagged and the customer left with it; not a valid void case, use refund workflow instead

response_200.reason: Customer changed their mind before leaving the store

step_3b_manager_rejects_instead._note: A human REJECTED decision (this endpoint) never populates terminal_id/fiscal_day_id/shift_id -- those are execution-only fields. REJECTED is reached ONLY through this explicit endpoint -- see approval-stale-context-scenarios.json for what happens when approve itself cannot execute (a 409, never an automatic REJECTED; corrected Stage 4 remediation pass 5 / Stage 2 amendment pass 4).

conflict_example_409.description: Approve attempted a second time against a void that already resolved (VOIDED, REJECTED, or already re-approved by a concurrent request)

error.message: This void has already been resolved and is no longer pending approval.
